visual.general_description: Text-only timeline of the patient's eight episodes from 1991 to 2022 with diagnosis, treatment and recovery time at each.
visual.detailed_description: A black horizontal arrow with eight year markers and alternating text boxes above and below describing each episode; no clinical images are shown.

panels.general_description: Horizontal black arrow timeline with eight year markers, each with a text box describing the episode, its diagnosis, treatment and recovery time.
panels.detailed_description: A black arrow runs left to right with eight open circles. The years 1991, 1999, 2008 and 2020 are printed above the arrow with text boxes above it, and the years 1996, 2002, 2014 and 2022 are printed below the arrow with text boxes below it. Each box lists presenting features, a diagnosis, treatment and a recovery time. The 1991 box reads fever, seizures, impairment of consciousness and psychiatric symptoms, diagnosis as viral encephalitis, treated with acyclovir and dexamethasone without ASMs, recovered in 2 months. 1996: seizures, impairment of consciousness and psychiatric symptoms, diagnosis as possible demyelinating encephalopathy, treated with dexamethasone without ASMs, recovered in 1 month. 1999: seizures, impairment of consciousness and psychiatric symptoms, diagnosis as encephalitis, treated with dexamethasone without ASMs, recovered in 1 month. 2002: same presenting features, diagnosis as recurrent encephalitis, MRI was normal, treated with dexamethasone without ASMs, recovered in 1 month. 2008: same presenting features, diagnosis as recurrent encephalitis, treated with methylprednisolone, VPA and clonazepam, recovered in 2 months. 2014: seizures, SE, impairment of consciousness, psychiatric symptoms and movement disorder, diagnosis as anti-NMDAR encephalitis, treated with methylprednisolone, IVIG, LEV and AZP, recovered in 6 months. 2020: seizures and SE, diagnosis as relapse anti-NMDAR encephalitis, treated with methylprednisolone, IVIG, LEV and MMF, recovered in half one month. 2022: seizures, diagnosis as autoimmune-associated epilepsy, treated with methylprednisolone, IVIG, LEV and MMF, recovered in 10 days.
